change: Only fixed generic formal-table unit guard; original inputs and all other event/row rules preserved.

policy.bridge: Require unique_same_accession_annual_pair in the fixed bridge METADATA. Each original current and prior cell must equal its selected GAAP Basic count or contain it in the preregistered native displayed rounding interval. Preserve exact and interval results separately. No changing the chosen accession or tolerance after mismatch.
policy.counts: Both original values must be finite strictly positive exact decimal strings with BASIC semantics. Accept the original independently verified share-specific units, or the fixed 34 AMD/MSFT/NVDA events' unchanged uniform formal-table units only when nonempty original unit/locator evidence agrees with the scale, displayed-to-decimal-to-shares normalization is exact, and the selected same-accession GAAP Basic cell is exactly equal with matching original-value strings. Rounding-interval compatibility alone cannot establish generic table units. Never change share_specific=false to true. No use of missing as zero.
policy.field: Same-original-report current and prior annual BASIC weighted-average EPS share denominators. Not diluted shares, year-end shares, exact repurchases, net issuance or employee-dilution cost.
policy.holds: Every inherited rejection code blocks this field, including the existing six excluded originals. Preserve all old admission, first-public, correction-history and security-master flags byte-for-byte inside original records; do not claim to resolve them.
policy.initial_partial: 2016-08-17 remains the exact incumbent without a new correction.
policy.knowledge_clock: known_at is the actual close of the second XNYS session strictly after the original date-only publication; usable_at is the later of that clock and the second XNYS close strictly after the selected GAAP corroborating filing date.
policy.numerical_activity: No ratios, features, ranks, orders, portfolio returns or new experiment registration occur in source admission. These require a separate frozen numerical PLAN.
policy.original_review: All 44 pairs and units must have independent numerical review. Common share basis is a declared same-report presentation assumption, supported by the two original annual columns plus same-accession GAAP corroboration; it is not certified complete split history.
policy.periods: Original current and comparison start/end dates must be known, each 330..400 inclusive calendar days, and current start exactly the day after comparison end. Both ends/starts must agree with the bridge-selected contexts. No annualization or substitution of future period evidence.
policy.raw_values: Use the independently re-extracted original display values normalized to shares, unchanged. Never replace with companyfacts or infer a split ratio.
policy.scope: The fixed 44 annual original events only, and every original 122x49 candidate row. No new source search or observation-account change.
policy.selection: Use each original signal close minus exactly42 full XNYS sessions. Select the latest known annual period before quality/admission tests. A known new blocked or not-yet-corroborated period blocks older periods. Maximum age550 calendar days since current period end. Keep original exact-symbol/issuer and report-use interval constraints.
source_limitations: Retrospectively retrieved original releases and companyfacts do not certify complete historical vintages or true first publication.
The bridge accession is the earliest matching cached 10-K, not an independently certified earliest original filing.
AMD and NVDA cached companyfacts currently lack corresponding origin/retrieval sidecars; retain this provenance limitation.
The original report-use interval is not proof of a complete historical security master.
This conditional research overlay does not modify strict data admission or any existing ledger.
